content.title: Definition of AFGHAN
content.text: 2 afghan : a blanket or shawl of colored yarn knitted or crocheted in strips or squares 3 afghan : a Turkoman carpet of large size and long pile woven in geometric designs Examples of Afghan in a Sentence Recent Examples on the Web Examples are automatically compiled from online sources to show current usage.
